Who we are We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here.
Senior AI Platform EngineerThe Dell Security & Resiliency organization manages the security risk across all aspects of Dells business. You will have an excellent opportunity to influence the security culture at Dell and further develop your career.  Join us as a Senior AI Platform Engineer on our Cybersecurity Vulnerability Management team in Bucharest, Romania to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact.What youll achieveAs a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying, operating, and securing the infrastructure and platform services that support AI-assisted Vulnerability Management workflows. You will work closely with AI engineers and security teams to enable reliable, scalable, and governed operation of AI agents, enterprise integrations, and automation services across Dells security ecosystem.You will:Design, deploy and operate the platform services, containerized workloads, and integration components that support AI-assisted Vulnerability Management workflows.Build and maintain secure integrations between orchestration platforms, enterprise security platforms, cloud services, workflow systems, and AI agent runtimes.Ensure reliability, scalability, observability, security, and operational resilience of AI and automation services.Design and maintain CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code processes supporting AI agent lifecycle management.Implement security controls, secrets management, approval gates, and audit capabilities for AI-enabled security workflows.Take the first step towards your dream careerEvery Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Heres what we are looking for with this role:Essential Requirements 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, cloud engineering, or backend infrastructure engineering;Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized platforms in enterprise environments, including cluster operations, workload deployment, networking, storage, and platform security;Experience designing and operating CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using platforms such as GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies;Strong proficiency in Python and automation engineering for platform integrations and operational tooling;Experience implementing observability, secrets management, access controls, resilience patterns, and production operational practices. Desirable Requirements Experience deploying or operating AI/ML platforms, LLM applications, agent orchestration frameworks, or DataRobot environments;Experience with GitOps, Kubernetes operators, service mesh technologies, or platform engineering practices supporting large-scale enterprise environments.
